meta.description: Operational visual scorecard for future visual gates.

axes.question: Does it feel like PRISMA and not generic SaaS?
Can price, total, stock and primary action be read fast?
Does the visual hierarchy reduce time to act?
Is there one clear primary story per screen?
Are surfaces and controls using the same visual grammar?
Are touch targets and destructive actions safely separated?
Are error, offline, sync and stock states impossible to miss?
How likely is this to break operation or readability? Lower is better.

blocked_if: primary CTA is not visually dominant in POS checkout context
touch target is below 44px on tablet or mobile
error/offline/sync state is hidden or styled as decorative
visual effect obscures price, stock, total or action label
PC tables lose scannability because of decorative spacing
